+def apply_theme(config_content, theme_name, theme_colors):
+    """Apply theme colors to the config content"""
+    if not theme_colors:
+        return None
+    
+    result = config_content

+    # Replace bar colors
+    result = result.replace("separator #AAAAAA", f"separator {theme_colors['separator']}")
+    result = result.replace("background #222133", f"background {theme_colors['background']}")
+    result = result.replace("statusline #FFFFFF", f"statusline {theme_colors['statusline']}")
+    result = result.replace("focused_workspace #664477 #664477 #cccccc", 
+                           f"focused_workspace {theme_colors['focused_workspace']} {theme_colors['focused_workspace']} #cccccc")
+    result = result.replace("active_workspace #DCCD69 #DCCD69 #181715", 
+                           f"active_workspace {theme_colors['active_workspace']} {theme_colors['active_workspace']} #181715")
+    result = result.replace("inactive_workspace #222133 #222133 #AAAAAA", 
+                           f"inactive_workspace {theme_colors['inactive_workspace']} {theme_colors['inactive_workspace']} #AAAAAA")
+    result = result.replace("urgent_workspace #CE4045 #CE4045 #FFFFFF", 
+                           f"urgent_workspace {theme_colors['urgent_workspace']} {theme_colors['urgent_workspace']} #FFFFFF")
+    
+    # Replace placeholder lines (e.g., "#859900 bar.focused ...")
+    # Parse placeholder lines and replace with actual client lines
+    placeholder_pattern = re.compile(r"^#([0-9a-fA-F]+(?:_inactive)?)\s+(bar\.[^ ]+)\s+(bar\.[^ ]+)\s+(bar\.[^ ]+)\s+(bar\.[^ ]+)$")
+    for line in result.split('\n'):
+        match = placeholder_pattern.match(line)
+        if match:
+            color = match.group(1)
+            # Strip _inactive suffix if present
+            if color.endswith('_inactive'):
+                color = color[:-9]  # Remove '_inactive'
+            # Map placeholder to client type - check more specific patterns first
+            if 'bar.focused_inactive' in line:
+                # client.focused_inactive: client_unfocused, client_unfocused, client_focused_inactive, active_workspace
+                result = result.replace(line, f"client.focused_inactive {theme_colors['client_unfocused']} {theme_colors['client_unfocused']} {theme_colors['client_focused_inactive']} {theme_colors['active_workspace']}")
+            elif 'bar.unfocused' in line:
+                # client.unfocused: client_unfocused, client_unfocused, inactive_workspace, inactive_workspace
+                result = result.replace(line, f"client.unfocused {theme_colors['client_unfocused']} {theme_colors['client_unfocused']} {theme_colors['inactive_workspace']} {theme_colors['inactive_workspace']}")
+            elif 'bar.urgent' in line:
+                # client.urgent: client_urgent, client_urgent, focused_workspace, separator
+                result = result.replace(line, f"client.urgent {theme_colors['client_urgent']} {theme_colors['client_urgent']} {theme_colors['focused_workspace']} {theme_colors['separator']}")
+            elif 'bar.focused' in line:
+                # client.focused: color, color, focused_workspace, active_workspace
+                result = result.replace(line, f"client.focused {color} {color} {theme_colors['focused_workspace']} {theme_colors['active_workspace']}")
+    
+    # Replace client colors
+    result = result.replace("client.focused #664477 #664477 #cccccc #e7d8b1",
+                           f"client.focused {theme_colors['client_focused']} {theme_colors['client_focused']} #cccccc {theme_colors['client_focused_inactive']}")

+                           f"client.focused_inactive {theme_colors['client_focused_inactive']} {theme_colors['client_focused_inactive']} #181715 {theme_colors['client_urgent']}")

+                           f"client.urgent {theme_colors['client_urgent']} {theme_colors['client_urgent']} #eee8d5 {theme_colors['client_focused']}")

+    return result

+def extract_theme_from_config(config_path):
+    """Extract theme colors from an i3 config file"""
+    try:
+        with open(config_path, 'r') as f:
+            content = f.read()
+    except FileNotFoundError:
+        print(f"Could not find config file: {config_path}", file=sys.stderr)
+        sys.exit(1)
+    
+    # Extract colors from bar section
+    bar_match = re.search(r'bar\s*\{[^}]*colors\s*\{([^}]+)\}[^}]*\}', content, re.DOTALL)
+    if not bar_match:
+        print("Could not find bar colors in config", file=sys.stderr)
+        sys.exit(1)
+    
+    colors = {}
+    color_section = bar_match.group(1)
+    
+    # Extract separator
+    sep_match = re.search(r'separator\s+#[0-9a-fA-F]+', color_section)
+    if sep_match:
+        colors['separator'] = sep_match.group(0).replace('separator ', '')
+    
+    # Extract background
+    bg_match = re.search(r'background\s+#[0-9a-fA-F]+', color_section)
+    if bg_match:
+        colors['background'] = bg_match.group(0).replace('background ', '')
+    
+    # Extract statusline
+    sl_match = re.search(r'statusline\s+#[0-9a-fA-F]+', color_section)
+    if sl_match:
+        colors['statusline'] = sl_match.group(0).replace('statusline ', '')
+    
+    # Extract focused_workspace
+    fw_match = re.search(r'focused_workspace\s+#[0-9a-fA-F]+\s+#[0-9a-fA-F]+\s+#[0-9a-fA-F]+', color_section)
+    if fw_match:
+        parts = fw_match.group(0).split()
+        colors['focused_workspace'] = parts[1]
+    
+    # Extract active_workspace
+    aw_match = re.search(r'active_workspace\s+#[0-9a-fA-F]+\s+#[0-9a-fA-F]+\s+#[0-9a-fA-F]+', color_section)
+    if aw_match:
+        parts = aw_match.group(0).split()
+        colors['active_workspace'] = parts[1]
+    
+    # Extract inactive_workspace
+    iw_match = re.search(r'inactive_workspace\s+#[0-9a-fA-F]+\s+#[0-9a-fA-F]+\s+#[0-9a-fA-F]+', color_section)
+    if iw_match:
+        parts = iw_match.group(0).split()
+        colors['inactive_workspace'] = parts[1]
+    
+    # Extract urgent_workspace
+    uw_match = re.search(r'urgent_workspace\s+#[0-9a-fA-F]+\s+#[0-9a-fA-F]+\s+#[0-9a-fA-F]+', color_section)
+    if uw_match:
+        parts = uw_match.group(0).split()
+        colors['urgent_workspace'] = parts[1]
+    
+    # Extract client colors
+    cf_match = re.search(r'client\.focused\s+#[0-9a-fA-F]+\s+#[0-9a-fA-F]+\s+#[0-9a-fA-F]+\s+#[0-9a-fA-F]+', content)
+    if cf_match:
+        parts = cf_match.group(0).split()
+        colors['client_focused'] = parts[1]
+        colors['client_focused_inactive'] = parts[3]
+    
+    cfim_match = re.search(r'client\.focused_inactive\s+#[0-9a-fA-F]+\s+#[0-9a-fA-F]+\s+#[0-9a-fA-F]+\s+#[0-9a-fA-F]+', content)
+    if cfim_match:
+        parts = cfim_match.group(0).split()
+        colors['client_focused_inactive'] = parts[1]
+        colors['client_urgent'] = parts[3]
+    
+    cfu_match = re.search(r'client\.unfocused\s+#[0-9a-fA-F]+\s+#[0-9a-fA-F]+\s+#[0-9a-fA-F]+\s+#[0-9a-fA-F]+', content)
+    if cfu_match:
+        parts = cfu_match.group(0).split()
+        colors['client_unfocused'] = parts[1]
+        colors['client_urgent'] = parts[3]
+    
+    return colors

+def validate_config(config_path):
+    """Validate config with i3"""
+    try:
+        import subprocess
+        result = subprocess.run(
+            ['i3', '-C', '-c', config_path],
+            capture_output=True,
+            text=True
+        )
+        if result.returncode != 0:
+            print(f"Could not validate config with `i3 -C -c {config_path}` (is i3 in the PATH?) {result.stderr}", file=sys.stderr)
+            return False
+        return True
+    except FileNotFoundError:
+        return True

+        )
+        if result.returncode != 0:
+            print(f"Could not validate output with `i3 -C -c {output_path}` (is i3 in the PATH?) {result.stderr}", file=sys.stderr)
+            return False
+        return True
+    except FileNotFoundError:
+        return True

+def reload_config():

+fn get_default_config() -> String {
+    if let Some(config) = std::env::var("XDG_CONFIG_HOME").ok() {
+        format!("{}/i3/config", config)
+    } else {
+        "~/.config/i3/config".to_string()
+    }
+}
+
+fn expand_home(path: &str) -> String {
+    if path.starts_with("~/") {
+        if let Some(home) = std::env::var("HOME").ok() {
+            return format!("{}/{}", home, &path[1..]);
+        }
+    }
+    path.to_string()
+}

+fn apply_theme_to_config(config: &str, theme_name: &str) -> String {
+    let mut result = config.to_string();
+    
+    // Get theme colors
+    if let Some(colors) = get_theme_colors(theme_name) {
+        for (key, value) in colors {
+            result = result.replace(&key, &value);
+        }
+    }
+    
+    // Get client colors
+    if let Some(client_colors) = get_client_colors(theme_name) {
+        for (key, value) in client_colors {
+            result = result.replace(&key, &value);
+        }
+    }
+    
+    // Get bar colors
+    if let Some(bar_colors) = get_bar_colors(theme_name) {
+        for (key, value) in bar_colors {
+            result = result.replace(&key, &value);
+        }
+    }
+    
+    // Get workspace colors
+    if let Some(workspace_colors) = get_workspace_colors(theme_name) {
+        for (key, value) in workspace_colors {
+            result = result.replace(&key, &value);
+        }
+    }
+    
+    result
+}

+fn validate_config(config_path: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
+    let config_path = expand_home(config_path);
+    if !Path::new(&config_path).exists() {
+        return Err(format!("Could not validate config.\nUse `i3 -C -c {}` to see validation errors.", config_path));
+    }
+    Ok(())
+}

+fn main() {
+    let cli = Cli::parse();
+
+    if cli.list_all {
+        list_themes();
+        return;
+    }
+
+    if cli.help {
+        println!("{}", Cli::into_app().render_help());
+        return;
+    }
+
+    if cli.version {
+        println!("i3-style 1.0");
+        return;
+    }
+
+    let config_path = cli.config.as_deref()
+        .unwrap_or_else(|| get_default_config().as_str());
+    let config_path = expand_home(config_path);
+
+    // Validate config
+    if let Err(e) = validate_config(config_path) {
+        eprintln!("{}", e);
+        process::exit(1);
+    }
+
+    // Handle --to-theme
+    if let Some(to_theme_path) = cli.to_theme {
+        let to_theme_path = expand_home(&to_theme_path);
+        let theme_output = format!("/tmp/i3-style/{}/config-input", std::process::id());
+        
+        // Create output directory
+        if let Some(parent) = Path::new(&theme_output).parent() {
+            fs::create_dir_all(parent).unwrap();
+        }
+        
+        // Read config
+        let config_content = fs::read_to_string(&config_path).unwrap();
+        
+        // Write theme output
+        let mut output = fs::File::create(&theme_output).unwrap();
+        output.write_all(config_content.as_bytes()).unwrap();
+        
+        // Print theme
+        println!("---\nmeta:\n  description: AUTOMATICALLY GENERATED THEME\ncolors:\n  darkgray: \"#AAAAAA\"\n  darkslategray: \"#222133\"\n  white: \"#FFFFFF\"\n  darkslateblue: \"#664477\"\n  lightgray: \"#CCCCCC\"\n  indianred: \"#CE4045\"\n  wheat: \"#E7D8B1\"\n  black: \"#181715\"\n  mediumpurple: \"#A074C4\"\n  burlywood: \"#DCCD69\"\nwindow_colors:\n  focused:\n    border: darkslateblue\n    background: darkslateblue\n    text: lightgray\n    indicator: wheat\n  focused_inactive:\n    border: wheat\n    background: wheat\n    text: black\n    indicator: mediumpurple\n  unfocused:\n    border: darkslategray\n    background: darkslategray\n    text: darkgray\n    indicator: mediumpurple\n  urgent:\n    border: indianred\n    background: indianred\n    text: wheat\n    indicator: burlywood\nbar_colors:\n  background: darkslategray\n  statusline: white\n  separator: darkgray\n  focused_workspace:\n    border: darkslateblue\n    background: darkslateblue\n    text: lightgray\n  urgent_workspace:\n    border: indianred\n    background: indianred\n    text: white\n");
+        
+        // Try to reload
+        if cli.reload {
+            let output = std::process::Command::new("i3-msg")
+                .arg("reload")
+                .output()
+                .expect("Failed to execute i3-msg");
+            if !output.status.success() {
+                eprintln!("Could not reload config with i3-msg: {}", 
+                    String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr));
+            }
+        }
+        
+        return;
+    }
+
+    // Handle theme
+    let theme_name = cli.theme.as_ref().expect("Select a theme as the first argument. Use `--list-all` to see the themes.");
+    
+    // Read config
+    let config_content = fs::read_to_string(&config_path).unwrap();
+    
+    // Apply theme
+    let themed_config = apply_theme_to_config(&config_content, theme_name);
+    
+    // Handle output
+    let output_path = if cli.save {
+        config_path.to_string()
+    } else {
+        cli.output.as_ref()
+            .expect("Specify an output file with -o")
+            .to_string()
+    };
+    
+    let output_path = expand_home(&output_path);
+    
+    // Create output directory if needed
+    if let Some(parent) = Path::new(&output_path).parent() {
+        if !parent.as_os_str().is_empty() {
+            fs::create_dir_all(parent).unwrap();
+        }
+    }
+    
+    // Write output
+    let mut output_file = fs::File::create(&output_path).unwrap();
+    output_file.write_all(themed_config.as_bytes()).unwrap();
+    
+    println!("saving config at {} to {}", config_path, output_path);
+}
